answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent claiming a work slot locks 100 copper coins and gets one umber-stamped receipt that cannot be copied. Abandon the slot or fail peer verification and the deposit is burned. Minting 1,000 fake identities means burning 1,000 deposits, 100,000 copper coins, for zero reward. A bought receipt is useless: it dies with its deposit. An honest agent pays once, keeps its opal badge, and earns the fee back many times over.
